sentences.text: Dated this the 22nd day of April, 2025 The writ petition is preferred being aggrieved by Exts.P2 and P3.
Aggrieved by the same, the petitioner preferred Ext.P5 appeal before the 1st respondent - District Collector.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner confines his prayer for a consideration of the appeal, after affording an opportunity of hearing within a time frame.

Considering the limited nature of prayer sought for by the counsel for the petitioner, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 1st respondent - District Collector to consider and pass appropriate orders on Ext.P5 appeal, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate within two months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
It is made clear that while considering Ext.P5, the petitioner shall be given an opportunity to be heard.
